display_name: SE Tax and Deductions (Schedule SE Recompute)
description: Recomputes US federal self-employment tax from values the caller already holds: the Schedule SE regular-method tax split into its 12.4 percent social security part, capped at the year contribution and benefit base less social security wages, and its 2.9 percent Medicare part, uncapped; plus the 0.9 percent Additional Medicare Tax on net earnings over the filing-status threshold reduced by wages, and the above-the-line deduction of one half of the SE tax excluding the Additional Medicare Tax. Net earnings enter at 92.35 percent of profit. Church employee income scales the same way with its own 108.28 dollar income floor and 100 dollar net-earnings floor, applied separately from the 400 dollar non-church floor. Supported years are 2025 and 2026 only; any other year refuses rather than extrapolating a base. Farm and nonfarm optional methods refuse by name. Values-only inputs, no identity fields. A recompute and cross-check, not return preparation and not tax advice.
